page.overview:
Who is Kraken Tom?

Kraken Tom is a kraken Yōkai with a navy blue body with a teal underside, five red eyes, jagged teeth, and 10 blue tentacles with two smaller tentacles near his mouth. His tentacular clubs each have a white claw and his back has seven blue cylindrical protrusions arranged in three columns, three rows of green tubes beneath them, and two black markings.

Kraken Tom debuted in "Many Unhappy Returns". He was engaged in a Battle Nexus match against a fellow Yōkai and easily defeated him. He sneezed after his nose was irritated by a thrown flower petal, resulting in him spitting fire on a spectator. He later was partnered with the Evil Six in a battle against Rat Jitsu and Leonardo. Kraken Tom was targeted by Splinter and Leo after they bested the Evil Six and found all of his tentacles pinned beneath the spikes of the Evil Six's helmets due to Leo's use of his mystic portals. Kraken Tom was knocked unconscious by Splinter after he was teleported above him and landed atop his head, losing the match.
